QuestInfo.name: Battle Mode Participation Prize
QuestInfo.0: Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that there is a Battle Mode challenge mission. Hurry over and challenge yourself!
QuestInfo.1: Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that if you participate in any mode 5 times, she will give you a gift.\n\n#rTip! You must fully complete a battle in order to get credit for it. If you leave in the middle or if one day passes, your quest progress will reset.
QuestInfo.2: You have completed the mission and received a gift.

0.0: Hello, #h0#! I am Rosette, the Battle Square guide. Right now, I am handing out gifts to those who complete challenges.
0.1: This mission is very easy. Just participate in any Battle Mode 5 times, and I'll give you a gift. You can do that, right?

yes.0: Great! Okay, just one thing to remember. You only get credit for participating if you complete one whole round, so don't leave the round early. Also, you have one day to finish the challenge, so don't waste time!

no.0: Really? It's not like it's hard...

1.0: See? I told you it was easy. It WAS easy, right? 'Course it was.

yes.0: 자, 이제 시작이에요. 다른 미션은 이것보단 어렵다구요. 하지만 당신이라면 달성하실 수 있을거예요. 파이팅!

default.0: 아직 미션을 달성하진 못했네요. 쉬운 미션이니까 금방 하실 수 있을 거에요.

quest.0: 아직 미션을 달성하진 못했네요. 쉬운 미션이니까 금방 하실 수 있을 거에요.
